1: // Minimal Meteor Defense game
2: // Canvas with id "game" assumed in the HTML
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   const width = canvas.width;
12:   const height = canvas.height;
13: 
14:   // Ship definition
15:   const ship = {
16:     w: 40,
17:     h: 20,
18:     x: width / 2 - 20,
19:     y: height - 30,
20:     speed: 6,
21:     color: '#0f0',
22:   };
23: 
24:   // Input handling
25:   const keys = {};
26:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
27:     keys[e.code] = true;
28:     if (e.code === 'Space') fire();
29:   });
30:   document.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
31:   canvas.addEventListener('click', fire);
32: 
33:   function fire() {
34:     projectiles.push({ x: ship.x + ship.w / 2, y: ship.y, r: 4, speed: 8 });
35:   }
36: 
37:   const projectiles = [];
38:   const meteors = [];
39:   let score = 0;
40:   let gameOver = false;
41: 
42:   // Spawn meteors
43:   function spawnMeteor() {
44:     const radius = 12 + Math.random() * 12;
45:     meteors.push({
46:       x: Math.random() * (width - 2 * radius) + radius,
47:       y: -radius,
48:       r: radius,
49:       speed: 1 + Math.random() * 2,
50:       color: '#f44',
51:     });
52:   }
53:   setInterval(spawnMeteor, 1000);
54: 
55:   function update() {
56:     if (gameOver) return;
57:     // Move ship
58:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
59:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.x += ship.speed;
60:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
61: 
62:     // Update projectiles
63:     for (let i = projectiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
64:       const p = projectiles[i];
65:       p.y -= p.speed;
66:       if (p.y < 0) projectiles.splice(i, 1);
67:     }
68: 
69:     // Update meteors
70:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
71:       const m = meteors[i];
72:       m.y += m.speed;
73:       // Collision with ship (simple AABB vs circle)
74:       const shipRect = { x: ship.x, y: ship.y, w: ship.w, h: ship.h };
75:       const distX = Math.abs(m.x - (shipRect.x + shipRect.w / 2));
76:       const distY = Math.abs(m.y - (shipRect.y + shipRect.h / 2));
77:       if (distX > shipRect.w / 2 + m.r || distY > shipRect.h / 2 + m.r) {
78:         // no collision
79:       } else {
80:         gameOver = true;
81:         break;
82:       }
83:       // Collision with projectiles
84:       for (let j = projectiles.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
85:         const p = projectiles[j];
86:         const dx = m.x - p.x;
87:         const dy = m.y - p.y;
88:         if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (m.r + p.r) * (m.r + p.r)) {
89:           meteors.splice(i, 1);
90:           projectiles.splice(j, 1);
91:           score++;
92:           break;
93:         }
94:       }
95:       // Remove if out of bounds
96:       if (m.y - m.r > height) meteors.splice(i, 1);
97:     }
98:   }

112:     // Meteors
113:     meteors.forEach(m => {
114:       ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
115:       ctx.beginPath();
116:       ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
117:       ctx.fill();
118:     });
119:     // Score
120:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
121:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
122:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
123:     // Game over overlay
124:     if (gameOver) {
125:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
126:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
127:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
128:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';

136:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
